record.question: The National Green Tribunal cannot hear any matter relating to: i) The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Cess Act, 1977 ii) The Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 iii) The Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 iv) The Public Liability Insurance Act, 1991
record.explanation: PDF page 9 (Q71) lists four Acts. The NGT Act, 2010 (Schedule I) covers the Water Cess Act, 1977, the Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 and the Public Liability Insurance Act, 1991, but not the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972. Therefore only item iii), option (b), is the one the NGT cannot hear.
